messages:
maya: FYI, during last night's staggered deploy we saw duplicate applies for a cold prefix belonging to tenant=acme. low noise but concerning.

arun: ugh. any logs? initial thought: ownership switch while a rehydrate/apply was inflight.

maya: small excerpt: ```[2026-03-22T23:12:07Z] tenant=acme prefix=usr-23 apply=ok node=shard-11
[2026-03-22T23:12:07Z] tenant=acme prefix=usr-23 apply=ok node=shard-3
[2026-03-22T23:12:08Z] tenant=acme prefix=usr-23 commit=ok node=shard-3```

rick: looks like shard-11 began rehydrate, then ownership moved to shard-3 before demote/quiesce finished -> double apply.

sasha: do we have any fence during demote? IIRC we only do a soft-drain and rely on a grace window.

arun: right now demote is cooperative. we don't block transfer on outstanding rehydration work. ops shortened drain window during the rollout which exposed this.

maya: risk: non-idempotent ops (checkpoints, counters, billing increments) could observe dup side-effects. we should pick mitigation path.

rick: short-term options: make downstream ops idempotent via op-id/tombstone checks, or add a demote fence that prevents ownership change until rehydrate completes.

sasha: also: add runtime flag that marks a prefix as "recently-thawed" and suppresses handoff for T seconds. telemetry: emit tag `rehydrate.reason=(cold|handoff|panic)` and `rehydrate.delay_ms`.

arun: runtime idea: when we detect an apply coming from a rehydrating prefix, attach a rehydrate-token. on handoff, if token age < threshold, sequencer routes reads/writes via the previous owner or serializes them. low perf hit but avoids races.

maya: ops/roll tradeoff: increasing drain timeout from 30s -> 90s cuts these races but slows upgrades. SRE input needed.

deploy-bot: rolling-upgrade shard-11 -> shard-3 completed 23:20 UTC :white_check_mark:

sasha: proposal: RFC "cold-prefix thaw handshake" covering: demote fencing semantics, minimal idempotency contract for apply ops, and new rehydrate metrics/alerts. include test harness to simulate handoff mid-rehydrate.

rick: i'll draft the RFC. will add a small sim that replays apply-log dup scenarios + assertions for idempotency.

arun: I'll follow up with a metrics PR and a lightweight sequencer-gate patch that treats <X-second rehydrates as suspicious.

maya: I'll open an incident note and loop in SRE for drain-window ops config. immediate mitigation: ops can enable an emergency flag to pause demotes until demote_ack_count >= N or rehydrate completes.

sasha: agree. timeline: RFC initial draft by Fri EOD, canary ops flag today if SRE approves.

maya: thanks all. we'll track in the incident and link RFC. closing here for now.
